mapping: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise techniques to NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls (mitigates)

note: Each technique ID lists the 800-53 Rev 5 controls the mapping says mitigate it. The mapping was made against ATT&CK 16.1; techniques added since have no entry, so kit-controls also uses the entries of IDs ATT&CK revoked in their favour, then the parent technique. A mapping is a starting point for review, not evidence that a control is in place. Not_in_attack lists mapped IDs the current ATT&CK data doesn't have, left out of the map.
